authority: Edition back-cover copy added by the publication build (owner instruction 2026-10-29: fix outstanding issues). It describes the game and adds no rules. The game facts beneath it stay verbatim from 1.1.
blurb: Banners rot and kings lie buried, but the ruins of the old world still glitter with coin, relics, and forgotten power. Lead a band of Heroes into the Dying Lands, race a rival party to the prize, and survive the Monsters that hunt you both. No one runs the Monsters: they follow their own scripts, so every player is free to play to win.
